name: Type
author: James Myers
description: Font Book for Omarchy. Every family on the machine, previewed in your own words, in your own theme. Drop a font file on the bar to install it, switch one off without uninstalling it, and remove the ones you added. Never touches a system directory and never asks for a password.

schema.label: Preview text
schema.description: What every font spells out. Empty uses a pangram, which is the point of a pangram.

schema.label: Preview size
schema.description: Point size for the sample line.

schema.label: Only fonts I installed
schema.description: Hide the ones that came with the system, which is most of them.
